corrections.old_text: ኑ ፡ ብሎ ፡ በፊት ፡ በፊት ፡ እየመራ ፡ ይዟዋ
corrections.corrected_text: ኑ ፡ ብሎ ፡ በፊት ፡ በፊት ፡ እየመራ ፡ ይዞዋ
corrections.reason: The glyph printed is 7th-order ዞ (ይዞዋቸው), not ዟ.
Both visually on the page and in Classical Ge'ez morphology (ወእለናቲሰ), the third character is 1st-order ለ, not 3rd-order ሊ.
The printed Ge'ez noun is በክሕዱ (6th-order ክ with top-left hook), matching standard Ge'ez morphology (ክሕድ).
Visually on the page and in Ge'ez verbal morphology (ይርእዩ from ርእየ/ረአየ), the character is 6th-order ር without a 5th-order loop.
